entries.title: Revelation of John 16:1
segments: Then I heard a loud voice, which came from the Temple, saying to the seven angels-- 'Go and empty the seven bowls of the Wrath of God upon the earth.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:2
segments: The first angel went and emptied his bowl upon the earth; and it turned to loathsome and painful sores upon all who bore the brand of the Beast and who worshiped its image.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:3
segments: Then the second angel emptied his bowl upon the sea; and it turned to blood like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing died--everything in the sea.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:4
segments: Then the third angel emptied his bowl upon the rivers and springs of water; and it turned to blood.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:5
segments: And I heard the Angel of the Waters saying-- 'Righteous art thou, thou who art and who wast, the Holy One, in inflicting this judgement;

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:6
segments: for men shed the blood of Christ's People and of the Prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:7
segments: And I heard the response from the altar-- 'Yes, O Lord, our God, the Almighty, true and righteous are they judgements.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:8
segments: Then the fourth angel emptied his bowl upon the sun; and he was permitted to scorch men with fire;

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:9
segments: and men were scorched by the intense heat. They blasphemed the Name of God who controlled these Curses, yet they did not repent and give him praise.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:10
segments: Then the fifth angel emptied his bowl upon the throne of the Beast; and darkness fell upon its Kingdom. Men gnawed their tongues for pain,

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:11
segments: and blasphemed the God of Heaven, because of their pains and because of their sores; yet they did not repent of what they had done.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:12
segments: Then the sixth angel emptied his bowl upon the great river Euphrates; and the water in the river was dried up, so that the road for the Kings of the East might be made ready.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:13
segments: And I saw three foul spirits, like frogs, come from the mouth of the Dragon and from the mouth of the Beast and from the mouth of the false Prophet.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:14
segments: They are the spirits of demons, and perform marvels; they go to kings all over the world, to collect them for the battle on the Great Day of Almighty God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:15
segments: ('I am coming like a thief! Happy will he be who is on the watch, and keeps his clothing at hand, so that he will not have to walk about unclothed and let men see his nakedness.')

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:16
segments: And the spirits collected the kings at the place called in Hebrew 'Har-Magedon.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:17
segments: Then the seventh Angel emptied his bowl upon the air. (A loud voice came from the throne in the Temple; it said 'All is over.')

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:18
segments: There followed 'flashes of lightning, cries, and peals of thunder'; and there was a great earthquake, such as had not occurred since man began to be upon the earth--none so great;

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:19
segments: and the great City was torn in three, and the cities of the nation fell, and God remembered Babylon the Great, and gave her the maddening wine-cup of his Wrath;

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:20
segments: and every island vanished, and the mountains disappeared.

entries.title: Revelation of John 16:21
segments: Great hailstones, a pound in weight, are falling upon men from the heavens. And men blasphemed God because of the Curse of the hail, for it was a very terrible Curse.
